claude.performance_metric: net income of $606M for FY2011 (up from $528M in 2010); no goodwill/intangible impairment required as of 2011-12-31
claude.rationale: The FY2011 10-K documents rising net sales ($5,531M→$5,636M→$5,903M, 2009-2011) and sustained net income ($555M/$528M/$606M), with the company retaining its integrated brand-ownership-plus-manufacturing-and-distribution model across three reportable segments and reporting no impairment of goodwill or indefinite-lived intangibles. No product/process incoherence is documented (Beverage Concentrates and Packaged Beverages segments both grew), driving p4_pathway=0. No operations-vs-organization fracture is documented (approx. 19,000 employees, alignment of brand ownership with manufacturing/distribution operations described as functioning), and the slice explicitly states "no documented fracture at the product/process or process/organization interface," driving p5_pathway=0.
